    'batch submit') items=('--provider' '--url' '--config') ;;

    'config init') items=('--config') ;;
    'config path') items=('--config') ;;

    'task sync') items=('--config') ;;
    'web') items=('--host' '--port' '--config') ;;
    'wrap') items=('--config') ;;
  esac
}

_rtok() {
  local cmd='' word i skip=0
  local -a items names
  for ((i = 2; i < CURRENT; i++)); do
    word=${words[i]}
    items=()
    if ((skip)); then
      skip=0
    elif [[ $word == -* ]]; then
      _rtok_values "$cmd"
      ((${items[(Ie)$word]})) && skip=1
    else
      _rtok_children "$cmd"
      names=(${items%%:*})
      ((${names[(Ie)$word]})) && cmd=${cmd:+$cmd }$word
    fi
  done
  items=()
  if ((skip)); then
    _files
  elif [[ $PREFIX == -* ]]; then
    _rtok_options "$cmd"
    _describe -t options option items
  else
    _rtok_children "$cmd"
    if ((${#items})); then
      _describe -t commands command items
    else
      _files
    fi
  fi
}

if [[ ${zsh_eval_context[-1]} == loadautofunc ]]; then
  _rtok "$@"
else
  compdef _rtok rtok
fi
